◈ FLASHBACK — Lucky Coin
Worn smooth. Kieran flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.
📺 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "We have designed a trial JUST for you. Based on our observations. Which are extensive. And flattering."
1. Trial of Stone — Endure. That is the whole trial. Endure.
2. Trial of Tongues — Talk the village through something hard.
3. Trial of the First Ember — Make fire the old way, from nothing.
Each trial takes a FULL day-part and leaves you drained (−250 kcal). Pick one. The System waits — it has already run the simulations, and it is terrible at keeping secrets.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
Aurora is on their feet before the talk dies down. "Raising hands against one of us. Said plain, in front of everyone." Heads turn. 3 days until the moot. Use them.

(A day-part, gone to the trial. −250 kcal. Your hands are shaking. The fans loved it.)

Aurora got their moot. The village got two fires and the space between them. Nobody calls that a win — least of all Aurora.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Tomás nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
